jp: 癒しの女神『ジュア』を妄執するあまり狂ってしまった者の姿。その姿に癒しは欠片も無い。見る限り、本人たちは幸せなようだが…。
jp_grezzo: "癒しの女神『ジュア』を妄執するあまり狂ってしまった者の姿。その姿に癒しは欠片も無い。見る限り、本人たちは幸せなようだが…。"
en: The figure of a person who has gone mad with delusion about the healing goddess Jure. There is not a shred of healing in their appearance. As far as the eye can see, they are happy...
en_grezzo: "The figure of a person who has gone mad with delusion about the healing goddess Jure. There is not a shred of healing in their appearance. As far as the eye can see, they are happy..."
it: L'aspetto di chi è impazzito a furia di rimuginare sulla dea che guarisce, Jure. Di guarigione, in quell'aspetto, non c'è nemmeno un briciolo. A vederli, però, sembrano felici...

jp: 彼らが生まれた町で生きる為にはその手を汚すしかなかった。その生きかた以外を彼等は知らない。不用心な人々からくすねた金で今日も彼らは生きていく。
jp_grezzo: "彼らが生まれた町で生きる為にはその手を汚すしかなかった。その生きかた以外を彼等は知らない。不用心な人々からくすねた金で今日も彼らは生きていく。"
en: They had to get their hands dirty in order to live in the town of their birth. They know no other way of life.They live today on the money they skim off the backs of the unwary.
en_grezzo: "They had to get their hands dirty in order to live in the town of their birth. They know no other way of life.They live today on the money they skim off the backs of the unwary."
it: Per vivere nella città dove sono nati non hanno potuto che sporcarsi le mani. Un altro modo di vivere non lo conoscono. Anche oggi tirano avanti con i soldi sfilati a chi non sta attento.

jp: 気が狂うほど気持ちがいいマッサージを行う。普段は客に対して猫撫で声で話すが、客が金を持っていないとわかると態度を急変させる。
jp_grezzo: "気が狂うほど気持ちがいいマッサージを行う。普段は客に対して猫撫で声で話すが、客が金を持っていないとわかると態度を急変させる。"
en: Gives massages that feel so good that they drive you crazy. They usually speak to customers in a catcall voice, but their attitude changes abruptly when they realise that the customer doesn't have any money.
en_grezzo: "Gives massages that feel so good that they drive you crazy. They usually speak to customers in a catcall voice, but their attitude changes abruptly when they realise that the customer doesn't have any money."
it: Fa massaggi così piacevoli da far uscire di testa. Di solito parla ai clienti con la voce melliflua, ma appena capisce che il cliente non ha soldi cambia atteggiamento di colpo.

jp: 捕らえられ囚われる者。積み上げた負のカルマを清算するのに要する時は数時間か数日か、或いは数年か。今日も独房で無実を訴える声が虚しく響き渡る。
jp_grezzo: "捕らえられ囚われる者。積み上げた負のカルマを清算するのに要する時は数時間か数日か、或いは数年か。今日も独房で無実を訴える声が虚しく響き渡る。"
en: Captives and prisoners. It takes hours, days or even years to clear the negative karma they have accumulated. Today, the voices of those pleading for their innocence echo in vain in their cells.
en_grezzo: "Captives and prisoners. It takes hours, days or even years to clear the negative karma they have accumulated. Today, the voices of those pleading for their innocence echo in vain in their cells."
it: Chi è stato catturato e tenuto rinchiuso. Per saldare il karma negativo che ha accumulato ci vogliono qualche ora, qualche giorno o forse qualche anno. Anche oggi, nelle celle, la voce di chi grida la propria innocenza risuona a vuoto.

jp: 彼らは「人生」というキャンパスに「生き様」と言う絵を描く。果たしてそれが傑作となるか、そしていつ完成するのかは彼ら次第である。
jp_grezzo: "彼らは「人生」というキャンパスに「生き様」と言う絵を描く。果たしてそれが傑作となるか、そしていつ完成するのかは彼ら次第である。"
en: They paint a picture of their 'way of life' on the canvas of 'life'. Whether it will be a masterpiece or not, and when it will be completed, is up to them.
en_grezzo: "They paint a picture of their 'way of life' on the canvas of 'life'. Whether it will be a masterpiece or not, and when it will be completed, is up to them."
it: Sulla tela che si chiama vita dipingono il quadro che si chiama modo di vivere. Se ne verrà fuori un capolavoro, e quando sarà finito, dipende soltanto da loro.

jp: 普段は刺激を求めて平民たちの生活を観察している。基本的に現金はあまり持ち歩かないが、裏では自身の性癖のために金を惜しみなく使う。
jp_grezzo: "普段は刺激を求めて平民たちの生活を観察している。基本的に現金はあまり持ち歩かないが、裏では自身の性癖のために金を惜しみなく使う。"
en: He usually observes the lives of commoners in search of excitement. Basically, he doesn't carry much cash, but behind the scenes he spends money lavishly for his own proclivities.
en_grezzo: "He usually observes the lives of commoners in search of excitement. Basically, he doesn't carry much cash, but behind the scenes he spends money lavishly for his own proclivities."
it: Di solito osserva la vita dei popolani in cerca di emozioni. Di contante in tasca ne porta poco, ma di nascosto spende senza risparmio per i propri gusti particolari.

jp: 魔術士ギルドの構成員。古文書の解読を仕事としており、その知識で魔法を使う事も出来るが、研究ばかりしてるため荒事は得意ではない。
jp_grezzo: "魔術士ギルドの構成員。古文書の解読を仕事としており、その知識で魔法を使う事も出来るが、研究ばかりしてるため荒事は得意ではない。"
en: A member of the Mages' Guild. His job is to decipher ancient texts, and he can use his knowledge to do magic, but he is not good at rough work as he is always researching.
en_grezzo: "A member of the Mages' Guild. His job is to decipher ancient texts, and he can use his knowledge to do magic, but he is not good at rough work as he is always researching."
it: Un affiliato della Gilda dei Maghi. Il suo lavoro è decifrare i testi antichi, e con quel sapere sa anche usare la magia, ma siccome sta sempre a studiare non è capace di menare le mani.

jp: 裏の世界に生きる者達の集まり。彼らには彼らなりの流儀があり。厳しい掟が課せられている。ルールを守って付き合う限りは、彼らの技能は大きな助けとなるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "裏の世界に生きる者達の集まり。彼らには彼らなりの流儀があり。厳しい掟が課せられている。ルールを守って付き合う限りは、彼らの技能は大きな助けとなるだろう。"
en: A group of people who live in the underworld. They have their own way of doing things. They have strict rules. Their skills can be of great help as long as you keep to the rules.
en_grezzo: "A group of people who live in the underworld. They have their own way of doing things. They have strict rules. Their skills can be of great help as long as you keep to the rules."
it: Un giro di gente che vive nel mondo di sotto. Hanno un loro modo di fare, e leggi severe a cui sottostare. Finché stai alle regole e le rispetti, la loro abilità è un grande aiuto.

jp: 基本的に物事を深く考えるのが苦手。しかしそれ故に一切の迷いを持たず、戦いの中では頼りになる。ギルドマスターに憧れを抱くものが多い。
jp_grezzo: "基本的に物事を深く考えるのが苦手。しかしそれ故に一切の迷いを持たず、戦いの中では頼りになる。ギルドマスターに憧れを抱くものが多い。"
en: Basically, he is not good at thinking things deeply. However, that is why they have no doubts at all and are very reliable in battle. Many of them have admiration for their guildmaster.
en_grezzo: "Basically, he is not good at thinking things deeply. However, that is why they have no doubts at all and are very reliable in battle. Many of them have admiration for their guildmaster."
it: Ragionare a fondo sulle cose, di norma, non gli riesce. Proprio per questo, però, non ha un solo dubbio, e in battaglia ci si può contare. In molti guardano al maestro della gilda con ammirazione.

jp: 自身に訪れるであろう光り輝く未来を信じて疑わない姿はまさに子供と呼ぶにふさわしい。どれほどの時間が過ぎようとも、それを盲信し続けるかぎり彼等は子供なのである。
jp_grezzo: "自身に訪れるであろう光り輝く未来を信じて疑わない姿はまさに子供と呼ぶにふさわしい。どれほどの時間が過ぎようとも、それを盲信し続けるかぎり彼等は子供なのである。"
en: Their unquestioning faith in the bright future that will come their way is what we call a child. No matter how much time passes, they are children as long as they continue to believe in it blindly.
en_grezzo: "Their unquestioning faith in the bright future that will come their way is what we call a child. No matter how much time passes, they are children as long as they continue to believe in it blindly. "
it: Credere senza un dubbio nel futuro luminoso che di sicuro arriverà: è proprio questo che merita il nome di bambino. Per quanto tempo passi, finché continuano a crederci ciecamente, bambini restano.

jp: 歳を重ねた者だけではなく、若くして身体のみが急激に老化してしまった者も含まれる。目的もなく街を徘徊するだけの日々が続く。
jp_grezzo: "歳を重ねた者だけではなく、若くして身体のみが急激に老化してしまった者も含まれる。目的もなく街を徘徊するだけの日々が続く。"
en: This includes not only those who have aged, but also those who have aged rapidly, but only physically, at a young age. They spend their days just wandering around the city aimlessly.
en_grezzo: "This includes not only those who have aged, but also those who have aged rapidly, but only physically, at a young age. They spend their days just wandering around the city aimlessly. "
it: Non ci sono soltanto quelli che hanno accumulato anni, ma anche quelli che, ancora giovani, hanno visto invecchiare di colpo il solo corpo. Le giornate passano tutte a girare per la città senza uno scopo.

jp: 古代文明の遺産と知識に傾倒し、奇妙な格好で機械を弄繰り回す変わり者達。彼らいわく、エイス・テールの異端者を真似ているのだという。
jp_grezzo: "古代文明の遺産と知識に傾倒し、奇妙な格好で機械を弄繰り回す変わり者達。彼らいわく、エイス・テールの異端者を真似ているのだという。"
en: These eccentrics are devoted to the legacy and knowledge of ancient civilisations, and play around with machines in strange outfits. They are, they say, imitating the heretics of Eyth Terre.
en_grezzo: "These eccentrics are devoted to the legacy and knowledge of ancient civilisations, and play around with machines in strange outfits. They are, they say, imitating the heretics of Eyth Terre. "
it: Tipi strani, votati all'eredità e al sapere delle civiltà antiche, che armeggiano con le macchine conciati in modo bizzarro. A sentir loro, imitano gli eretici di Eyth Terre.

jp: 肉は食用となり、乳は栄養満点で、体毛は衣服に使えると至れり尽くせり。脱走して近所の畑で盗み食いを働いているものも多い。
jp_grezzo: "肉は食用となり、乳は栄養満点で、体毛は衣服に使えると至れり尽くせり。脱走して近所の畑で盗み食いを働いているものも多い。"
en: The perfect animal: edible and delicious meat, produces nutritional milk, and grows wool that can be used for clothing. Many escape their pens and snack on the neighboring fields.
en_grezzo: "The perfect animal: edible and delicious meat, produces nutritional milk, and grows wool that can be used for clothing. Many escape their pens and snack on the neighboring fields."
it: La carne si mangia, il latte nutre da matti e il pelo serve per i vestiti: non le manca proprio niente. Tante scappano dal recinto e vanno a rubare nei campi qui intorno.

jp: ティリス各地を跳び回る野生の渡り蛙。水中を遊泳するかのように空中を泳ぐが原理は不明。子供でも倒せるため、おやつとして人気。
jp_grezzo: "ティリス各地を跳び回る野生の渡り蛙。水中を遊泳するかのように空中を泳ぐが原理は不明。子供でも倒せるため、おやつとして人気。"
en: A species of flying frog found all over North Tyris. They can \"swim\" through the air as easily as swimming through water, though how this functions is unknown. Since even children are strong enough to take one down, they're a popular snack.
en_grezzo: "A species of flying frog found all over North Tyris. They can \"swim\" through the air as easily as swimming through water, though how this functions is unknown. Since even children are strong enough to take one down, they're a popular snack."
it: Una rana migratrice selvatica che saltella per tutta Tyris. Nuota nell'aria come se nuotasse sott'acqua, ma con che principio non si sa. Ad abbatterla riesce anche un bambino, e per questo è uno spuntino molto amato.

jp: 働きもせずにあたりをぶらつき、恐喝やスリまがいのことをして食い扶持を得ている。強そうに粋がってはいるものの、実力の程はお察しである。
jp_grezzo: "働きもせずにあたりをぶらつき、恐喝やスリまがいのことをして食い扶持を得ている。強そうに粋がってはいるものの、実力の程はお察しである。"
en: Unemployed hooligans that wander about using blackmail and picking pockets in order to support themselves. They look strong and put up a brave front, but their true strength you can probably guess.
en_grezzo: "Unemployed hooligans that wander about using blackmail and picking pockets in order to support themselves. They look strong and put up a brave front, but their true strength you can probably guess."
it: Bighellona senza lavorare e si guadagna il pane con l'estorsione e con qualcosa che somiglia al borseggio. Fa il gradasso e sembra forte, ma su quanto valga davvero c'è poco da illudersi.

jp: 犬のような頭部を持つ小鬼。加工しにくいためあまり使われていないが、鉱石の一種である｢コバルト｣はこの魔物の名前から取られたと言われている。
jp_grezzo: "犬のような頭部を持つ小鬼。加工しにくいためあまり使われていないが、鉱石の一種である｢コバルト｣はこの魔物の名前から取られたと言われている。"
en: A small monster with the head of a dog. Though it's difficult to process and so isn't used very often, the ore \"cobalt\" is said to come from this monster.
en_grezzo: "A small monster with the head of a dog. Though it's difficult to process and so isn't used very often, the ore \"cobalt\" is said to come from this monster."
it: Un piccolo mostro con la testa da cane. Lavorarlo è difficile e quindi non lo si usa granché, ma dicono che il nome del minerale cobalto venga proprio da questa bestia.

jp: 人に似た姿を持つ獣。彼らは愚かでか弱く、単体では人間の子供と同程度の能力しか持たないが、それを補うように数を持って攻めてくる。
jp_grezzo: "人に似た姿を持つ獣。彼らは愚かでか弱く、単体では人間の子供と同程度の能力しか持たないが、それを補うように数を持って攻めてくる。"
en: Beasts with a human-like appearance. They are stupid and frail, and on their own are only as capable as human children, but they attack with numbers to compensate.
en_grezzo: "Beasts with a human-like appearance. They are stupid and frail, and on their own are only as capable as human children, but they attack with numbers to compensate. "
it: Una bestia dall'aspetto simile a quello dell'uomo. Sono sciocchi e deboli, e da soli valgono quanto un bambino umano, ma per rimediare attaccano in tanti.

jp: 人に似た姿を持つ獣。イークの中でも厳しい鍛錬に耐えたもののみが戦士の称号を授かる。そのため戦士であることを誇りとしている。
jp_grezzo: "人に似た姿を持つ獣。イークの中でも厳しい鍛錬に耐えたもののみが戦士の称号を授かる。そのため戦士であることを誇りとしている。"
en: Beasts with a human-like appearance. Only those who have endured the most rigorous training among the Yeeks are awarded the title of warrior. For this reason, they are proud to be warriors.
en_grezzo: "Beasts with a human-like appearance. Only those who have endured the most rigorous training among the Yeeks are awarded the title of warrior. For this reason, they are proud to be warriors."
it: Una bestia dall'aspetto simile a quello dell'uomo. Fra gli yeek, soltanto chi ha retto un allenamento durissimo riceve il titolo di guerriero. Ed è per questo che di esserlo va fiero.

jp: 他の同族と比べて遠くから攻撃する知性を持ったイーク。弓を扱おうと弦を引き続けた結果、同族の戦士程ではないが身体が鍛えられている。
jp_grezzo: "他の同族と比べて遠くから攻撃する知性を持ったイーク。弓を扱おうと弦を引き続けた結果、同族の戦士程ではないが身体が鍛えられている。"
en: The yeek has the intelligence to attack from a distance compared to other members of his tribe. As a result of continually pulling the strings to handle the bow, his body has been trained, although not as well as the warriors of his own tribe.
en_grezzo: "The yeek has the intelligence to attack from a distance compared to other members of his tribe. As a result of continually pulling the strings to handle the bow, his body has been trained, although not as well as the warriors of his own tribe. "
it: Uno yeek che, rispetto agli altri della sua gente, ha l'intelligenza di attaccare da lontano. A furia di tendere la corda per maneggiare l'arco si è irrobustito, anche se non quanto i guerrieri dei suoi.

jp: 産まれた時からマスターとなるべく定められた、エリート中のエリート。同族を率いる指揮能力に秀でており、数多くのイークを使役している。
jp_grezzo: "産まれた時からマスターとなるべく定められた、エリート中のエリート。同族を率いる指揮能力に秀でており、数多くのイークを使役している。"
en: Elite of the elite, destined to become a master from birth. They excel in their ability to command and lead their own people, and they have commanded a large number of Yeeks.
en_grezzo: "Elite of the elite, destined to become a master from birth. They excel in their ability to command and lead their own people, and they have commanded a large number of Yeeks. "
it: Il migliore fra i migliori, destinato fin dalla nascita a diventare maestro. Eccelle nel comandare e nel guidare la propria gente, e ha ai suoi ordini un gran numero di yeek.

jp: イーク族の身体能力の低さを克服しようと選んだ手段は、自身の命を犠牲にした自爆だった。だが、簡単に起爆してしまい味方も巻き込んでしまう。
jp_grezzo: "イーク族の身体能力の低さを克服しようと選んだ手段は、自身の命を犠牲にした自爆だった。だが、簡単に起爆してしまい味方も巻き込んでしまう。"
en: The means they chose to overcome the low physical capabilities of the Yeeks was self-destruction at the cost of their own lives. However, it was easily detonated and their allies were also collateralised.
en_grezzo: "The means they chose to overcome the low physical capabilities of the Yeeks was self-destruction at the cost of their own lives. However, it was easily detonated and their allies were also collateralised. "
it: Il mezzo che hanno scelto per rimediare alle poche doti fisiche degli yeek è stato farsi esplodere, sacrificando la propria vita. Solo che l'innesco parte con niente, e nell'esplosione ci finiscono dentro anche i compagni.

jp: 東の国を追放された戦士の成れの果て。オチムシャと呼ばれる彼らは、家のため名誉のため戦場での華々しい死を望んでいるとされるが、本当は死ぬのがすごく怖いらしい。
jp_grezzo: "東の国を追放された戦士の成れの果て。オチムシャと呼ばれる彼らは、家のため名誉のため戦場での華々しい死を望んでいるとされるが、本当は死ぬのがすごく怖いらしい。"
en: They are the result of warriors exiled from the East. Known as Ochimsha, they are said to want to die spectacularly on the battlefield for the sake of their home and honour, but they are actually very afraid of dying.
en_grezzo: "They are the result of warriors exiled from the East. Known as Ochimsha, they are said to want to die spectacularly on the battlefield for the sake of their home and honour, but they are actually very afraid of dying. "
it: Quel che resta dei guerrieri cacciati dal paese d'oriente. Li chiamano ochimusha, e si dice che desiderino una morte splendida sul campo, per la casata e per l'onore, ma in verità pare che di morire abbiano una paura tremenda.

jp: 何の変哲もない岩が変異して魔物となった。こちらニヤニヤと笑いながら眺めているが、少しの刺激でも爆発してしまうため処理する際は遠くから慎重に行うべきである。
jp_grezzo: "何の変哲もない岩が変異して魔物となった。こちらニヤニヤと笑いながら眺めているが、少しの刺激でも爆発してしまうため処理する際は遠くから慎重に行うべきである。"
en: An ordinary rock has mutated into a monster. It is watched with a grin, but even the slightest provocation can cause it to explode, so it should be handled carefully from a distance.
en_grezzo: "An ordinary rock has mutated into a monster. It is watched with a grin, but even the slightest provocation can cause it to explode, so it should be handled carefully from a distance. "
it: Una roccia qualunque che è mutata ed è diventata un mostro. Ti guarda con un sorrisetto, ma basta un urto da niente perché esploda, e quindi conviene occuparsene da lontano e con prudenza.

jp: テロリストが生化学文明の遺物を悪用して製造したクローン人間。人込みに紛れて爆発させるのが目的。テロリストが遺物の使い方をよく分かっていないため、みんな同じ姿で出力されてしまう。爆発に命を賭けることが芸術だと、本能的に刷り込まれている。
jp_grezzo: "テロリストが生化学文明の遺物を悪用して製造したクローン人間。人込みに紛れて爆発させるのが目的。テロリストが遺物の使い方をよく分かっていないため、みんな同じ姿で出力されてしまう。爆発に命を賭けることが芸術だと、本能的に刷り込まれている。"
en: Cloned human beings produced by terrorists exploiting relics of biochemical civilisations. The aim is to detonate them in crowded places. As the terrorists do not know how to use the relics well, they are all output in the same appearance. They are instinctively imprinted with the idea that risking their lives in an explosion is an art form.
en_grezzo: "Cloned human beings produced by terrorists exploiting relics of biochemical civilisations. The aim is to detonate them in crowded places. As the terrorists do not know how to use the relics well, they are all output in the same appearance. They are instinctively imprinted with the idea that risking their lives in an explosion is an art form."
it: Cloni umani prodotti dai terroristi con un uso storto dei resti della civiltà biochimica. Lo scopo è farli esplodere in mezzo alla folla. Siccome i terroristi non hanno capito bene come si usano quei resti, escono tutti con lo stesso aspetto. Nell'istinto gli hanno impresso che giocarsi la vita in un'esplosione sia arte.

jp: イーク界の絶対のカリスマ。高い知能を持ち、種族全体をまとめ上げている。仲間を集めヨウィンの農作物を略取しようと画策している。
jp_grezzo: "イーク界の絶対のカリスマ。高い知能を持ち、種族全体をまとめ上げている。仲間を集めヨウィンの農作物を略取しようと画策している。"
en: Absolute charisma of the yeek world. Highly intelligent, he unites the entire tribe. He plans to gather his friends and plunder Yowyn's crops.
en_grezzo: "Absolute charisma of the yeek world. Highly intelligent, he unites the entire tribe. He plans to gather his friends and plunder Yowyn's crops."
it: Il carisma assoluto del mondo degli yeek. Ha un'intelligenza alta e tiene unita l'intera stirpe. Sta tramando di radunare i suoi e di razziare i raccolti di Yowyn.

jp: 温泉の魅力に取りつかれ、呪いのごとく温泉につかり続ける者たち。すでに全身がふやけている。温泉の魅力について尋ねようものならマニアックな話を延々と聞かされるのでやめたほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "温泉の魅力に取りつかれ、呪いのごとく温泉につかり続ける者たち。すでに全身がふやけている。温泉の魅力について尋ねようものならマニアックな話を延々と聞かされるのでやめたほうがいい。"
en: Those who have fallen under the spell of the hot springs and continue to bathe in them like a curse. Their whole body is already soaked. If you try to ask about the charms of hot springs, you will be told endless maniacal stories, so it's best not to try.
en_grezzo: "Those who have fallen under the spell of the hot springs and continue to bathe in them like a curse. Their whole body is already soaked. If you try to ask about the charms of hot springs, you will be told endless maniacal stories, so it's best not to try."
it: Gente presa dal fascino delle terme, che continua a stare a mollo come sotto una maledizione. Il corpo ce l'hanno già tutto raggrinzito dall'acqua. Se ti viene in mente di chiedere che cosa abbiano di bello le terme ti tocca un discorso infinito da fanatici, e allora meglio lasciar perdere.

jp: 土の多い場所を好んで生息し、様々な地域で見かける事が出来る。攻撃には使わないが毒をもっており、食べると吐き気を催す。
jp_grezzo: "土の多い場所を好んで生息し、様々な地域で見かける事が出来る。攻撃には使わないが毒をもっており、食べると吐き気を催す。"
en: A small creature that lives in soil, and thus appears in many places. Though it doesn't use it to attack, the creature does contain poison, so eating it will make you sick.
en_grezzo: "A small creature that lives in soil, and thus appears in many places. Though it doesn't use it to attack, the creature does contain poison, so eating it will make you sick."
it: Vive volentieri dove c'è molta terra, e lo si incontra nelle zone più diverse. Per attaccare non lo usa, ma il veleno ce l'ha, e a mangiarlo viene la nausea.

jp: 死体を養分に成長する菌糸類。エーテルの影響で突然変異を起こして巨大化した。胞子も巨大化しており攻撃手段になっている。
jp_grezzo: "死体を養分に成長する菌糸類。エーテルの影響で突然変異を起こして巨大化した。胞子も巨大化しており攻撃手段になっている。"
en: A mushroom that feeds on decaying corpses in order to grow. Exposure to Ether has caused it to mutate and grow to gigantic sizes. That includes its spores, which it uses as a weapon.
en_grezzo: "A mushroom that feeds on decaying corpses in order to grow. Exposure to Ether has caused it to mutate and grow to gigantic sizes. That includes its spores, which it uses as a weapon."
it: Un fungo che cresce nutrendosi dei cadaveri. L'etere lo ha fatto mutare all'improvviso e diventare enorme. Anche le spore sono diventate enormi, e gli servono per attaccare.

jp: 自生した土壌や空気のせいか、胞子に毒を含むようになったきのこ。むやみに食せば腹痛にのた打ち回ることになるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "自生した土壌や空気のせいか、胞子に毒を含むようになったきのこ。むやみに食せば腹痛にのた打ち回ることになるだろう。"
en: Mushrooms that have become poisonous in their spores due to the soil and air in which they grow. If consumed carelessly, the mushrooms can cause abdominal pain.
en_grezzo: "Mushrooms that have become poisonous in their spores due to the soil and air in which they grow. If consumed carelessly, the mushrooms can cause abdominal pain. "
it: Un fungo a cui, forse per il terreno in cui è spuntato o per l'aria, le spore si sono riempite di veleno. A mangiarlo alla leggera ci si ritrova a rotolare per il mal di pancia.

jp: 混沌の力を取り込んだ菌糸類で、胞子で敵を狙い撃ちじわじわと弱らせる。その危険な胞子はさまざまな苦しみを与える力を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の力を取り込んだ菌糸類で、胞子で敵を狙い撃ちじわじわと弱らせる。その危険な胞子はさまざまな苦しみを与える力を持つ。"
en: A mycelium that has taken on the power of chaos, it uses its spores to target and slowly weaken its enemies. Its dangerous spores have the power to inflict various kinds of suffering.
en_grezzo: "A mycelium that has taken on the power of chaos, it uses its spores to target and slowly weaken its enemies. Its dangerous spores have the power to inflict various kinds of suffering. "
it: Un fungo che ha assorbito la forza del caos e che, con le spore, prende di mira il nemico e lo indebolisce piano piano. Quelle spore pericolose hanno il potere di infliggere sofferenze di ogni sorta.

jp: 街で暮らす人々。子供の誕生日を祝ったり、パーティーに行ったり、人の物を欲しがったり、モンスターに襲われたりと忙しい日々を送っている。
jp_grezzo: "街で暮らす人々。子供の誕生日を祝ったり、パーティーに行ったり、人の物を欲しがったり、モンスターに襲われたりと忙しい日々を送っている。"
en: People who live in a city. They'll keep you busy by asking you to provide them birthday gifts, performing for parties, getting things from other people, and protecting the town from monsters.
en_grezzo: "People who live in a city. They'll keep you busy by asking you to provide them birthday gifts, performing for parties, getting things from other people, and protecting the town from monsters."
it: Gente che vive in città. Festeggia il compleanno dei figli, va alle feste, si mette in testa la roba degli altri, viene assalita dai mostri: sono giornate piene.

jp: どこの町にもいる、なんら変わったところの無い一般市民。彼らは一般に光物を収集することを好むが、同時に食べ切れなくて腐ってしまった食料を捨てきれずに持ち歩く一面も持つ。
jp_grezzo: "どこの町にもいる、なんら変わったところの無い一般市民。彼らは一般に光物を収集することを好むが、同時に食べ切れなくて腐ってしまった食料を捨てきれずに持ち歩く一面も持つ。"
en: They are ordinary citizens in every town, who are not different in any way. They generally like to collect light objects, but at the same time they have a side that carries around uneaten and rotten food that they can't throw away.
en_grezzo: "They are ordinary citizens in every town, who are not different in any way. They generally like to collect light objects, but at the same time they have a side that carries around uneaten and rotten food that they can't throw away. "
it: Cittadini comuni, che si trovano in qualunque paese e non hanno niente di diverso dagli altri. In genere amano collezionare le cose che luccicano, ma insieme hanno anche il vizio di portarsi dietro il cibo che non sono riusciti a finire e che è marcito, senza decidersi a buttarlo.

jp: エイス・テールの遺産とも言われる機械で出来た巨大な建築物、アクリ・テオラに暮らす人々。人工的に整えられた快適な環境で過ごし、機械信仰が盛んに行われている。
jp_grezzo: "エイス・テールの遺産とも言われる機械で出来た巨大な建築物、アクリ・テオラに暮らす人々。人工的に整えられた快適な環境で過ごし、機械信仰が盛んに行われている。"
en: People live in Cyber Dome, a huge structure made of machines, which is said to be the legacy of Eyth Terre. They live in an artificially prepared and comfortable environment and have a thriving machine religion.
en_grezzo: "People live in Cyber Dome, a huge structure made of machines, which is said to be the legacy of Eyth Terre. They live in an artificially prepared and comfortable environment and have a thriving machine religion. "
it: Gente che vive nella Cupola Cibernetica, l'enorme costruzione fatta di macchine che dicono sia un lascito di Eyth Terre. Passano le giornate in un ambiente comodo, regolato per via artificiale, e il culto della macchina è molto praticato.

jp: ヴェルニースの南西の森の中に存在する怪しげな建物に住む人々。一説によるとそこは旧文明の遺産とも言うべき存在であり、とある神の祝福を受けているとかいないとか。
jp_grezzo: "ヴェルニースの南西の森の中に存在する怪しげな建物に住む人々。一説によるとそこは旧文明の遺産とも言うべき存在であり、とある神の祝福を受けているとかいないとか。"
en: People live in a mysterious building that exists in the forest south-west of Vernis. According to one theory, it is a legacy of the old civilisation and may or may not have been blessed by a certain god.
en_grezzo: "People live in a mysterious building that exists in the forest south-west of Vernis. According to one theory, it is a legacy of the old civilisation and may or may not have been blessed by a certain god. "
it: Gente che vive in un edificio sospetto in mezzo al bosco a sud-ovest di Vernis. Secondo una certa teoria è un lascito della vecchia civiltà, e forse ha ricevuto la benedizione di una certa divinità, o forse no.

jp: 彼らが取り扱う商品は、各種不動産や遺産相続の権利書から、果ては銃器に至るまで多岐にわたる。まさに揺り籠から墓場までカバーしていると言えよう。
jp_grezzo: "彼らが取り扱う商品は、各種不動産や遺産相続の権利書から、果ては銃器に至るまで多岐にわたる。まさに揺り籠から墓場までカバーしていると言えよう。"
en: The products they handle range from various types of property and inheritance rights to firearms. It can be said that they cover everything from the cradle to the grave.
en_grezzo: "The products they handle range from various types of property and inheritance rights to firearms. It can be said that they cover everything from the cradle to the grave. "
it: La merce che tratta va dai beni immobili di ogni sorta e dai titoli di eredità fino, in fondo, alle armi da fuoco. Si può proprio dire che copra tutto, dalla culla alla tomba.

jp: 海を愛し、船を繰って異国を渡り行く仕事人。海は海賊や危険な魔物が多いくせにやりすごすことも難しく、水夫にとって地上の港町は安らぎの場所らしい。
jp_grezzo: "海を愛し、船を繰って異国を渡り行く仕事人。海は海賊や危険な魔物が多いくせにやりすごすことも難しく、水夫にとって地上の港町は安らぎの場所らしい。"
en: A man of business who loves the sea and sailing his ship across foreign lands. The sea is full of pirates and dangerous monsters, but it is also difficult to get around them, and it is said that port towns on the ground are a place of peace for sailors.
en_grezzo: "A man of business who loves the sea and sailing his ship across foreign lands. The sea is full of pirates and dangerous monsters, but it is also difficult to get around them, and it is said that port towns on the ground are a place of peace for sailors. "
it: Un uomo di mestiere che ama il mare e che, manovrando la nave, passa da un paese straniero all'altro. Il mare è pieno di pirati e di mostri pericolosi, e scansarli non è facile: per un marinaio pare che le città portuali sulla terraferma siano il posto della quiete.

jp: 海に生き、波風を浴び、命も同等である船を駆って各国を渡り行く猛者。熟練しても予測の難しいエーテルの風により船とともに海の藻屑となるケースが多い。
jp_grezzo: "海に生き、波風を浴び、命も同等である船を駆って各国を渡り行く猛者。熟練しても予測の難しいエーテルの風により船とともに海の藻屑となるケースが多い。"
en: A fierce warrior who lives on the sea, bathed in waves and winds, and travels across countries in a ship whose life is equal to his own. Even the most skilled of sailors often end up with their ships in the sea due to the ether winds, which are difficult to predict.
en_grezzo: "A fierce warrior who lives on the sea, bathed in waves and winds, and travels across countries in a ship whose life is equal to his own. Even the most skilled of sailors often end up with their ships in the sea due to the ether winds, which are difficult to predict. "
it: Un fiero che vive sul mare, si prende in faccia onde e vento e passa da un paese all'altro guidando una nave che vale quanto la sua vita. Per quanto sia esperto, capita spesso che il vento d'etere, difficile da prevedere, se lo porti in fondo al mare insieme alla nave.

jp: 慈悲深く慎み深いジャビ王の妃。夫のことを深く愛しており、パルミア国内では理想的な夫婦としても有名。物腰は柔らかいが、賊に対しては見下すような態度をとることも。
jp_grezzo: "慈悲深く慎み深いジャビ王の妃。夫のことを深く愛しており、パルミア国内では理想的な夫婦としても有名。物腰は柔らかいが、賊に対しては見下すような態度をとることも。"
en: Queen of the benevolent and modest King Jabi. She is deeply in love with her husband and is well known in Palmia as the ideal couple. She is soft-spoken, but can be condescending towards bandits.
en_grezzo: "Queen of the benevolent and modest King Jabi. She is deeply in love with her husband and is well known in Palmia as the ideal couple. She is soft-spoken, but can be condescending towards bandits."
it: La sposa di re Xabi, uomo pieno di misericordia e di riserbo. Ama il marito profondamente, e in tutta Palmia sono famosi come la coppia ideale. I modi sono gentili, ma con i briganti sa prendere un'aria di disprezzo.
